steps.why_en: Reminder letters only run on manual trigger and printer upload is blocked in settings.
steps.why_id: Surat reminder hanya jalan lewat trigger manual dan upload percetakan diblok di setting.

steps.en: The system suspends the notice automatically
steps.why_en: It only happens inside the letter run, which needs a manual trigger.
steps.why_id: Hanya terjadi di proses surat yang butuh trigger manual.

steps.en: A specific suspension code is used for the vehicle type
steps.id: Dipakai kode suspension khusus sesuai jenis kendaraan

steps.en: The suspension is temporary with a set period
steps.id: Suspension bersifat sementara dengan periode tertentu
steps.why_en: The code applies a permanent suspension with no period.
steps.why_id: Code menerapkan suspension permanen tanpa periode.

steps.en: The suspended notice does not move to the next stage
steps.id: Notice yang di-suspend tidak naik ke tahap berikutnya
